title: Introduction au $\partial\bar{\partial}$-Neumann
summary: In this paper, we shall use the $L^2$ existence theorems for $\partial\bar{\partial}$ provide by Guy Laville to etablish for existence theorem for the $\partial\bar{\partial}$-Neumann operator on any bounded pseudoconvex starred domaine $Ω$ in $\mathbb{C}^n$ based on the work of D. Spencer on the $\bar{\partial}$-Neumann. As a result, we obtain a new method for resolving the $\partial\bar{\partial}. $
